question: Do repeated counterbalanced compact claim-link batches preserve structured claim coverage while reducing provider input and completion time?

exploratory_predecessor.use: capability motivation only; excluded from confirmation estimates

call_budget.reset_credits: do not consume without explicit operator approval

confirmation_thresholds.quality: all eight candidate critiques have every expected claim status, correct attribution and verdict, same-claim finding links, and zero unlinked findings
confirmation_thresholds.order_check: each candidate passes structured quality twice in first position and twice in second position

stop_rules: Run exactly one scheduled batch per invocation and never retry automatically.
Stop after any excluded run, schema or attribution failure, claim-status miss, invalid link, unlinked finding, harness failure, or current-window usage at or above 60 percent.
Preserve every attempted run directory and commit its evidence before another call.
Do not count any predecessor or capability call in confirmation estimates.
Do not generalize beyond two independent compact review capsules from these two fixtures.
